key_facts: July 29 REVIEW (Irish Times July 29, Reuters/Straits Times July 28-29, La Nacion July 29, PassBlue July 24): UNSC President Zenon Mukongo Ngay (DRC) confirmed the first closed-door white-ballot straw poll takes place tomorrow morning, Thursday July 30, across all 7 candidates (Grossi, Grynspan, Rodrigues-Birkett, Bachelet, Espinosa, Sall, and late entrant 75yo Ugandan diplomat Olara Otunnu). Irish Times calls IAEA DG Rafael Grossi 'the smoothest performer during last week's town hall' and 'often spoken of as the favourite', while emphasizing strong momentum for the first female UNSG (Grynspan, Bachelet, Espinosa, Rodrigues-Birkett); Reuters stresses 'no clear front-runner'. PassBlue July 24 highlighted strong Town Hall performances by Grossi, Grynspan (citing Black Sea Grain Initiative), and Rodrigues-Birkett (drawing on 2024-25 UNSC membership). No major last-minute shift or P5 endorsement leaked; holding calibrated distribution unchanged ahead of tomorrow's vote: Grossi 0.37, Grynspan 0.36, Rodrigues-Birkett 0.13, Bachelet 0.06, Sall 0.04 (sum 0.96).
next_review_trigger: CRITICAL WATCH July 30: check immediately after Thursday July 30 morning UNSC first straw poll leaks (PassBlue/Reuters/AFP/Security Council Report) to update to 0.99 on the top 'encourage' vote-getter.
